So, the question is essentially asking if it's appropriate to use a tissue for blowing your nose. It's considered hygienic because tissues are disposable and prevent the spread of germs. I remember when I was younger, my parents always kept tissues handy, especially during flu season. They taught me to use tissues instead of handkerchiefs because tissues can be thrown away after use, reducing the chance of spreading illnesses. But wait, are there any situations where using a Kleenex might not be appropriate? But that's more of a personal choice rather than a right or wrong issue.
